subject: design-technology
title: The Design Cycle
welcome_lead: Explore, define, ideate, prototype, test — the loop.
meta_desc: KS3 D&T: design process steps and cycle.
final_note: Designers cycle through stages, not march in a line.

concepts.def: Starting statement of the design task.

walkthroughs.body_html: The design cycle has stages: Brief → Research → Ideation → Prototype → Test → Evaluate. Then around again. Iterative = repeat to improve.
Research looks at existing products (what works, what doesn't), user needs, materials, costs. Primary research is your own; secondary is from books/internet.
You don't finish each step once. After testing you might go back and redesign. Most products take many trips around the cycle before launching.
